title: 跨節點累計、Shadow/Enforce 模式切換、月初重置與臨時覆寫 (Cross-Node Fair-Use, Shadow/Enforce, Monthly Reset & Temporary Override)
expected: Fair-Use policy enforces tier invariants, aggregates member usage across multiple serving exits (node & node2), transitions from shadow to enforce mode pushing updated MemberRatePolicy to serving exits and clearing fair_use.applying once acknowledged, supports audited temporary member overrides with expiry, and resets to Tier 0 at the next UTC calendar month.
actual: Live multi-node test enrolled second exit 01a18eb7-e7d5-7e1d-bf67-60db74591a03 (node2), routed memberA traffic across both 01a18e52-b663-70aa-858c-12d0cd359d20 and 01a18eb7-e7d5-7e1d-bf67-60db74591a03 (aggregating 505222 bytes > Tier 2 threshold 6000 B across 5 exits), verified shadow mode (60Mbit on node, 15Mbit on node2) and Tier 2 5Mbit/2Mbit kernel tc enforcement on both exits, and uncovered two product defects in w3-policy-fup: (1) fair_use activation / fup.member_generation_changed does not trigger desiredstate.Compiler.RecompileBatch (desired_config_generation stayed at 68 until grant update), and (2) pgNodeAckReader.GetMemberNodeAckStatus reads the wrong JSON column/generation on node_observations, leaving GET /api/v1/member/usage fair_use.applying=true.
blockers: Owner w3-policy-fup (internal/fup/engine.go:1507 pgNodeAckReader.GetMemberNodeAckStatus): queries `no.checks->'applied_policy_refs'->>'fup_generation'` instead of `no.report_payload->'applied_policy_refs'->>'fup_generation'` and compares fleet policy revision generation against per-member fup_member_states.generation, causing GET /api/v1/member/usage `fair_use.applying` to remain permanently `true` even after all serving nodes apply the new generation and update kernel tc HTB classes.

mechanism_checks.name: CrossNodeUsageAggregationAndPerExitRateScope
mechanism_checks.summary: Usage from Exit Node 1 (60 GB) and Exit Node 2 (55 GB) merges into one 115 GB period total crossing Tier 1 (100 GB); each exit computes its own directional rate_scope effective rate (Node 1: 25 Mbps, Node 2: 15 Mbps).

mechanism_checks.name: ShadowModeVsEnforceModeAndNodeAckSummary
mechanism_checks.summary: Shadow mode records would_apply_tier_index=1 with generation=0 and unthrottled node rates; switching to enforce mode increments generation=1 and applies Tier 1.

mechanism_checks.name: AdminOverrideExpiryAndNewMonthPeriodReset
mechanism_checks.summary: SetOverride elevates member to 100 Mbps (state=override, gen=2) until valid_until, automatically restores Tier 1 (25 Mbps, gen=3) on expiry, and resets to Tier 0 (state=normal, gen=4) at 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.
